notes.title: Dev Update – May 2025: A New Dimension of Chaos!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey BOTS commanders! 
[/b]

We’ve been cooking up something big behind the scenes — and while there’s no new demo just yet, this update gives you a peek 👀  at the major shifts coming to[b] BOTS 4 DEFENSE[/b] that will shape the next big version of the game.

🧱[b] From Flat to Full(er) Dimension[/b]
We’ve transitioned from a flat 2D  ➡️ plane to a more 🧭dynamic 3D environment using 2D art. Don’t worry — it still has that crisp[b] pixel charm, [/b]but now with depth 🧊✨, lighting, and shadows that make the battlefield pop!

Expect better clarity🔍, smoother visuals, and juicier effects. Your towers, bots, and enemies now cast proper shadows, and everything from vending machines to pipes feels more alive.🍇

🤖[b]Bots Now Have Drivers?![/b]
That’s right — we’re introducing playable characters that “drive” the bots. 🚗 You’re no longer just placing defenses — [b]you are the operator [/b]inside the machine. This opens up tons of future gameplay possibilities and boosts the feel of co-op action. 🧑‍✈️

🗺️[b]New Level Flow: Sections with Purpose[/b]

We’re overhauling how levels play out: 

⚔️Each run now has [b]3 Combat Sections[/b] filled with action and enemies.
🎁Between them, [b]2 Loot Sections[/b] give you breathing room — and rewards!
You’ll find:
💡 One-time energy chests
⚡ Temporary boosts that last only for the current session (like longer tether range or combat perks 🛡️⚔️)
This new structure brings more variety, tension, and reward pacing to every playthrough 🎲.

🔮[b] What’s Next?[/b]
We’re currently working on systems that will:
📦 Tie session boosts to loot and player choices
🧭 Expand chest types, rewards, and room variety
🤝 Deepen the co-op experience through more character interactions

We’ll share more when it’s ready. [b]For now, thanks for being with us during the ride[/b]. The foundation is changing — and the next version of the game will feel like a whole new machine.

[b]Stay tuned & stay charged,
 The B4D Team[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes (v0.02.66s)
notes.notes:
[b]Big Updates & New Features! 🚀[/b]

After a short break over the Christmas and New Year holidays, we jumped right back into full-speed development! While we’ve been incredibly busy improving Bots 4 Defense, we didn’t have much time to stay active on Discord—but that changes now!

Our focus was to complete all the new features in time for the Couch Co-op Festival on Steam, and along the way, we made huge improvements to the game’s mechanics, visual effects, and overall progression system. We’re happy to say that we’ve achieved almost everything we planned, and the game now feels smoother, more dynamic, and more fun than ever!

[b]Here’s a breakdown of the biggest changes:
[/b]
🔥[b] What’s New?[/b]
✅ Kick Mechanic – You can now kick objects, props, and even enemies to reposition them!
✅ Dash Rework – Dash no longer pushes objects (that’s what kick is for now!), but it helps you cover large distances, jump over gaps, and phase through obstacles and enemies.
✅ Attack Combo Upgrade – Instead of a 3-hit combo, we now have a 5-hit combo, with the final hit dealing the most damage!
✅ Combo Bar – A new combo meter appears below the player's score, filling up as you attack and perform actions. It drains if you take damage, but once filled, you get a temporary power boost!
✅ New Enemy Alert! – Meet the rogue bug that doesn’t follow lanes like other enemies. Instead, it targets the player directly and shoots from a distance!
✅ Progression Overhaul – Unlike the previous demo, not all mechanics are unlocked from the start. Now, players learn and unlock them progressively throughout the game.
✅ Reworked Levels – With all these changes, the game's flow and challenge have drastically evolved, creating fresh and exciting new levels!
✅ Improved Tower Placement – Bouncer and Stomp towers now display their range when placing them, helping players maximize their effectiveness.
✅ Better Character Movement – We fine-tuned character pivots to make movement and direction changes feel as smooth as possible.
✅ Bug Fixes & Polishing – We’ve squashed several small bugs to improve overall gameplay stability and experience.

🎯[b] What’s Next?[/b]
We’re not slowing down! Here’s what we’re focusing on next:

🔊 More Sound Effects – We’re adding tons of new sounds to enhance player feedback and overall immersion.
🎨 Visual Improvements – Expect more polish in combat effects and tower interactions to make everything feel more dynamic and responsive.
🔍 More New Features – We have a few exciting ideas in the works, but we’re keeping them under wraps for now! Some will take more time to test and refine, but we’re confident they’ll make the game even better once fully implemented.

We’re excited for you to try out all these updates and would love to hear your feedback! Let us know what you think, and as always, thank you for being part of this journey with us! 🎮💙

notes.title: Patch Notes (V0.02.50s)
notes.notes:
Game Update Announcement

[h3]Hello defenders![/h3]

We’re excited to announce a fresh update to the game! Dive into some fantastic new features and improvements that we believe will elevate your experience. Here’s what’s new in this build:
[h3]
🚀 New Towers[/h3]
Bouncer: Halt enemies in their tracks across multiple lanes – a perfect addition for crowd control!
360° Stomp: Nothing gets past this powerhouse! Watch it stop any advance in its path.
Flamethrower: Unleash fiery mayhem on any enemies caught in its scorching range.

[h3]🏗️ Choose Your Path[/h3]
Non-linear progression is here! Players now have the freedom to select towers, giving you more flexibility to adapt your strategy as you advance.

[h3]🎨 Visual Upgrades[/h3]
Burst Tower has received a visual upgrade with new projectiles to make it even more impactful in battle.
[h3]
🐞 Bug Fixes & Balance Tweaks[/h3]
We've fixed several persistent bugs, ensuring smoother gameplay.
Rebalancing adjustments have been made to ensure a fair and challenging experience.
Jump back into the action and try out the new updates! Your feedback helps us grow, so let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more exciting content coming soon.

Good luck, and happy defending!

notes.title: Patch Notes (v0.02.44s)
notes.notes:
[h3]1. Boosts for All Towers[/h3]

    We have implemented boosts for all towers, enhancing their performance and abilities. This includes 
    special attacks, barriers, energy drops etc. Good luck finding them all!

[h3]2. New Towers Added[/h3]

Three new towers have been added to the game (for now they remain locked):

[*] Flame Tower: Deals fire damage to enemies within its range inflicting percentage damage of enemy HP.
[*]Stomp Tower: Slows down enemies by stunning them for a brief period.
[*]Bouncer Tower: Strikes multiple enemies with a bouncing ball of energy.

[h3]3. Replicator Logic[/h3]

Introduced new logic for the Replicator, allowing it to spawn enemies.

[h3]4. Expanded Card System[/h3]

The card system has been expanded to include four cards, providing more options and strategies for players to choose from.

[h3]5. Bug Fixes[/h3]

Various bugs have been fixed to improve the overall gameplay experience. This includes fixes for UI issues, performance optimizations, and more.

[h3]6. Beam Animation and Invulnerability[/h3]

[*]Added a new beam animation for certain attacks and abilities.
[*]Players now have a brief period of invulnerability when they spawn, giving them a chance to get into 
    the action without immediately taking damage.

[h3]7. Balancing Adjustments[/h3]

[*]Tower and Enemy Balancing: Adjusted the strength of towers and enemies to ensure a more 
   balanced and challenging gameplay experience.
[*]Map and Level Balancing: Made adjustments to the difficulty by changing spawning patterns in order 
   to provide a more engaging and fair experience for players.

[h3]8. Other Enhancements[/h3]

Added a new calculation for enemy HP multiplier based on number of active players.

notes.title: Patch Notes (v0.02.38s)
notes.notes:
[h2]Remote Play Together[/h2]
We are excited to announce that[b] Steam's Remote Play Together[/b] is now enabled! You can now invite your friends to join your game online through the Steam Overlay. Your friends do not need to download the demo; they just need to accept your invite and start playing together.


[h2]Player Controls[/h2]
We have revamped the player inputs to provide three ways to play the game: the left side of the keyboard, the right side of the keyboard, and a gamepad. All control schemes are compatible with Steam's Remote Play Together.

To activate a control scheme, press the action button on the respective layout:
[list]
[*] J for the left part of the keyboard
[*] Numpad1 for the right side of the keyboard
[*] "South button" on a gamepad (e.g., A on an Xbox controller)
[/list]
We have tested multiple gamepads, including generic gamepads and the PS5 gamepad. Please report any issues you find with your gamepad, and we will be more than happy to look into it.


[h2]Player Joining into the Game[/h2]
From the Main Menu forward, any player that wants to join the game must activate the desired controller by pressing the [b]Action [/b]button. This will take up the first available slot (P1, P2, P3, P4).


[h2]Options Menu[/h2]
The options menu has been updated to include visualization of control schemes. We have added options to both the Main Menu and the Game menu. During the game, you can access the options by pressing [b]Pause[/b].


[h2]Tech Panel[/h2]
The tech panel has been updated, and a tutorial explaining how to use it has been added. You can access the tech panel as soon as level 4 from the Map Screen.


[h2]Confirmation Panel[/h2]
We have added confirmation panels to the [b]NewGame[/b], [b]ExitMatch[/b], and [b]ExitGame[/b] actions to ensure you don't accidentally perform these actions.
